steps.en: Install Axolotl into a fresh uv environment and fetch the example configs
steps.zh: 在新的 uv 环境里装好 Axolotl，拉下示例配置
steps.code: uv pip install --no-build-isolation axolotl[deepspeed] · axolotl fetch examples

steps.en: Edit one YAML: base model, dataset and its format, LoRA or full tuning
steps.zh: 改一份 YAML：底座模型、数据集及格式、LoRA 还是全参

steps.en: Downloads the base model and attaches LoRA/QLoRA adapter layers
steps.zh: 下载底座模型，挂上 LoRA/QLoRA adapter 层

steps.en: Formats and tokenizes the dataset, packing short samples together
steps.zh: 按格式处理数据并分词，把短样本拼接在一起

steps.en: Runs the training loop with the configured FSDP2/DeepSpeed parallelism
steps.zh: 按配置的 FSDP2/DeepSpeed 并行方式跑训练循环

steps.en: Saves the adapter or full weights to the output directory
steps.zh: 把 adapter 或完整权重存到输出目录

value.en: A fine-tune is one reviewable YAML file instead of a fragile training script per model and cluster
value.zh: 一次微调就是一份可审阅的 YAML，不再是每个模型、每个集群一份脆弱的训练脚本

sources: https://github.com/axolotl-ai-cloud/axolotl#-quick-start---llm-fine-tuning-in-minutes (uv pip install --no-build-isolation axolotl[deepspeed], axolotl fetch examples, axolotl train examples/llama-3/lora-1b.yml)
https://github.com/axolotl-ai-cloud/axolotl/blob/main/docs/getting-started.qmd (what axolotl train does: download model, apply LoRA, process dataset, train, save)
